related.title: 推測式解碼：接受率與驗證回合
related.titleEn: Speculative decoding: acceptance and verification rounds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：格式可逆、索引合法、容量包含全部三陣列，稀疏率未直接宣稱加速比。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Format is reversible, indices valid, all arrays counted, and sparsity is not speedup.
related.difference: 區分提出token、接受token與最終輸出，計入草稿成本及正確拒絕修正。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish proposed, accepted and emitted tokens, including draft cost and rejection correction.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CSR容量=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes；稠密容量=rows×cols×valueBytes。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 100×100矩陣，FP16值2 bytes、欄索引與列偏移各4 bytes，nnz2000。 CSR=2000×6+101×4=12404 bytes；稠密20000 bytes。
常數獨立接受率α、γ個草稿及一個額外輸出時，每回合理想期望Σ(k=0..γ)α^k；只是簡化模型。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 γ3、α0.8，先不計草稿與驗證時間差；分布保持另需正確演算法。 期望=1+0.8+0.64+0.512=2.952 token/回合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CSR bytes=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes; dense bytes=rows×cols×valueBytes. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 100×100 matrix, FP16 values2 bytes, indices/offsets4 bytes, nnz2000. CSR12404 bytes versus dense20000 bytes.

With independent constant acceptanceα,γ drafts and one extra output, ideal expected output isΣα^k for k0..γ. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. γ3,α0.8, initially excluding draft/verification timing; distribution preservation requires the correct algorithm. Expected output=2.952 tokens/round.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: VGG：小卷積堆疊的成本與非線性

related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：格式可逆、索引合法、容量包含全部三陣列，稀疏率未直接宣稱加速比。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Format is reversible, indices valid, all arrays counted, and sparsity is not speedup.
related.difference: 在每個3×3後標ReLU與張量尺寸；用顏色畫出三次擴張後的7×7依賴範圍。；6912與27648計數正確，且報告明確區分相同感受野與不同非線性映射。
related.differenceEn: Mark ReLU and tensor shape after each3×3 layer; color the final7×7 dependency region.; Counts6912 and27648 must match, and the report distinguishes equal receptive fields from different nonlinear mappings.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: CSR容量=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes；稠密容量=rows×cols×valueBytes。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 100×100矩陣，FP16值2 bytes、欄索引與列偏移各4 bytes，nnz2000。 CSR=2000×6+101×4=12404 bytes；稠密20000 bytes。
在相同Cin=Cout=C、不計偏置時，三層3×3參數為27C²；單層7×7為49C²，感受野皆7但函數不等價。；教學C=16，步幅1、等尺寸補零；比較三層3×3與一層7×7。；堆疊P=3×9×16²=6912；C改32時P=27648。單層7×7在C16時為12544。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: CSR bytes=nnz(valueBytes+indexBytes)+(rows+1)offsetBytes; dense bytes=rows×cols×valueBytes. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 100×100 matrix, FP16 values2 bytes, indices/offsets4 bytes, nnz2000. CSR12404 bytes versus dense20000 bytes.

A7×7 layer at C16 uses12544.
